actions.requirement: All named authors satisfy all four ICMJE criteria and agree authorship/order; actual final approval/accountability are required.

actions.concrete_action: Authors review the final JNE PDF and editor-facing documents and make truthful final approval/accountability/authorship declarations. Do not fabricate signatures or additional contributions.

actions.requirement: The same or essentially the same article must not be simultaneously under consideration elsewhere. Disclosure does not itself decide substantial distinctness.
actions.current_evidence: PLOS remains under review; comparison identifies an archived PLOS source, while actual current portal files remain unavailable.
actions.concrete_action: Reconcile the comparison with the actual under-review PLOS version, include it with the existing editor-facing disclosure for assessment, and answer the originality declaration truthfully. This audit neither certifies distinctness nor mandates withdrawal/contact on the authors behalf.
actions.copy_requirement_scope: Supplying the actual copy is the practical comparison/disclosure fix; this audit does not claim that the generic public policy explicitly specifies an upload slot for every related work.

actions.requirement: Data statement must tell readers where/how to access data.

actions.concrete_action: Retain the accurate original source citation; check the BNCI link from another network before submission and, if access remains restricted, add a verified working official/versioned mirror URL already supported by the input provenance.
